QUERY 'refund policy' FROM release_validation_docs LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1 SCORE THRESHOLD 0.7 LOOKUP FROM profile_vectors VECTOR 'preferences' USING HYBRID
QUERY 'refund policy for annual plan' FROM release_validation_docs LIMIT 3 USING HYBRID
QUERY 'refund policy for annual plan' FROM release_validation_docs LIMIT 3 EXACT

QUERY 'refund policy for annual plan' FROM release_validation_docs LIMIT 3 USING HYBRID WITH (rrf_k = 30, rrf_weights = [0.7, 0.3])
